text: The Weird Sisters (Luna, Phoebe, and Seline) are three of the Children of Oberon. They are featured in the Disney animated series Gargoyles. They are avatars of Vengeance (or Fury), Grace, and Fate.

King Tut (also referred to as the Egyptian Koopa) is a boss in Mario Pinball Land. He is a large ancient Egyptian–themed Koopa Troopa who is located inside the pyramid in the Shifting Sands Stage and is capable of floating. King Tut first appears as a statue, but he comes to life when Mario reaches the boss's room and presses the floor panel. He attacks Mario by using enchanted obelisks to make magic spheres appear; the spheres follow Mario, and when they touch him, they make him smaller and more likely to fall out of the area. However, if Mario hits the enchanted obelisks, he will become bigger. To attack King Tut, Mario has to run into the enchanted obelisks to make himself extra large and

Koopa no Yukidaruma is a giant snowman shaped like Bowser, antagonist of the sixth chapter of volume 1 of Super Mario-kun. In that chapter, Lakitu attacks Mario, Luigi, and Yoshi by creating a snow valley in Donut Plains, then creates a giant snowman in the shape of Bowser. Mario and Luigi laugh at the statue's crooked eyes, which then attacks them, offended. Lakitu explains that the statue has not only the shape of Bowser, but also his personality. The trio tries to burn it with their combined fireballs, but the snowman's ice breath freezes the fireball as well as Luigi and Yoshi. Mario saves himself with the Cape and attacks it with a snowball, but ends up only powering it up. Finally, wit

Cutie Honey also know as Cutey Honey is a media franchise created by Go Nagai in a series of different manga, anime, OVA, live-action TV and movies. The series focuses on Honey Kisaragi, an android modeled after Dr. Kisaragi's late daughter. She is outfitted with a unique device known by a variety of names that allows Honey to create matter from air and allow her transformations into various forms, the most famous being the titular Cutey Honey a red (or pink)-haired swordswoman armed with a rapier and a boomerang. Within the several different series are the villainous Panther Zora and Sister Jill, in most series they lead the all-women inhuman organization Panther Claw. They seek several val

is an anime and manga series created by Go Nagai and Tatsuya Yasuda. It introduced the Magne Robo series of Takara's Magnemo line (for a while surpassing Chogokin). The series tells the adventures of 25-year old Hiroshi Shiba, a racer and son of renowned scientist Senjiro Shiba. One day Hiroshi is revealed to have been made into a cyborg by his father after a special bronze bell was implanted into him. Along with this, he can change into the head of the super robot Steel Jeeg to fight the evil Jamatai Empire. Hiroshi is assisted by his late father's assistant Miwa Uzuki who pilots the ship that gives Jeeg his body parts. Later years had Jeeg make a comeback through the Super Robot Wars video
Jungle Evil was a Zanzibar Land mercenary who specialized in ambush techniques and guerilla warfare as the self-styled "King of the Jungle."

.]] Slippy Toad is the mechanic for the Star Fox team. He made inventions like the Arwing, Blue Marine, and the Landmaster. Although he was skilled at piloting the Landmaster, he was terrible at flying the Arwing, which necessitated for him to be rescued from enemy ships getting a lock on him.
With the Bubble Clone Technique, Utakata creates a clone of himself by using his Soap Bubble Ninjutsu with his bubble pipe. When hit, the clone pops like a bubble.

As the originator of Orochimaru's Juinjutsu and the possessor of a unique clan ability, Jūgo is able to give his flesh to those that are compatible with said cursed seals, thus healing any injuries they may have received. Because he is transferring his cells to the recipient, Jūgo's own body regresses in age, becoming younger in appearance. The effects, however, are temporary and can be reverted using the counterpart for this technique.

Kimimaro produces long, hardened bones from his body that can easily puncture opponents, dealing serious damage. There is no set way in which the bones are used for this "dance": Tō no Sho likens his movements to the branches of a willow, swaying in the wind. In keeping with this, Kimimaro's movements while using this technique are mostly evasive and his attacks are primarily parries and counters. Kimimaro usually only uses bones sprouted from the palms of his hands, but if these aren't enough he can produce additional bones from his knees, elbows, and shoulders so that he can attack multiple targets at once.

Tenten tosses and unrolls her large scroll over the opponent, summoning countless kunai from the scroll to rain down on the opponent. She then summons four large chains that collapse on the opponent, forcing them down to the ground. es:Armas Manipuladas: Desastre Celestial de Acero pl:Sōgu: Tenkosai

Shinki uses his Iron Sand to seal an individual in a sphere. As long as the user is alive, the seal will remain active and the individual will be in stasis. Only the user can release the seal. The seal also keeps the victim alive, even if they have what would otherwise be fatal injuries, buying time for a medic ninja to heal them,
Obito sends the opponent into his pocket dimension and uses the block formations to crush them.

Maki uses her cloth for defensive means by wrapping it around her and any nearby allies, she can form a protective barrier. The cloth can be made around a nearby object such as a rock, to better hold down the fortification. If the cloth is made wet by a Water Release technique, it allows the dome to defend against powerful heat-based attacks.

Ibiki summons a giant iron maneki neko, which appears beneath the opponent from underground, split down the middle. The statue clamps around the target and is then wrapped in chains, which drag it back down into the ground.
Dan's soul leaves his body, and enters the body of his opponent. Inside, it destroys their opponent's soul before returning to Dan's body.

The user applies their hand to a target's face, allowing them to take the face and use it as their own. Because it's the actual face that they're using and not a disguise, the user runs no risk of being discovered due to imperfections or minor flaws. The bodies of those whose faces have been stolen are, as a consequence, quite ghastly to look upon. After Orochimaru uses this technique to take the face of a Kusagakure-nin, his voice changes as well, though it's not clear if that's part of this technique. As he takes damage in combat, the stolen face gradually wrinkles before finally tearing away, revealing Orochimaru's face underneath. Orochimaru can also remove the face himself when he no lo

Kushina creates a barrier seal on the ground. If the opponent steps on the barrier seal, two frying pans appear in the sky and fall on the opponent, knocking them unconscious. pl:Ashimoto Chūitsu! pt-br:Cuidado onde Pisa!
Touch-Up is a member of the Phreaks. She is a cyberneticist and hacker.

The Bone Queen is a unique Stygian Revenant located in The Belly of the Beast Level 1 in Act 4. She uses similar skills to other Stygian Revenants, except that instead of reviving undead, she summons Corrupted Beasts and Corrupted Rhoas, and resurrects their not destroyed corpses.

Xixic, High Necromancer is a unique necromancer located in . He is based on Sawbones from The Upper Prison. He raises undead and summons skeletons. Unlike other necromancers he can raise magic monsters.

A Predator, who was most commonly referred to as as a Bogey, visited Earth in 1997 to observe dangerous deep-sea creatures in hopes of discovering potential worthy adversaries to hunt by using humans as bait.

The Gasbag was a Pathogen-mutant created from exposure of an unknown lifeform to the Chemical A0-3959X.91 – 15 that was encountered on LV-558. The Gasbag was prone to self-detonation when in proximity of a non-Pathogen creature, showering them in toxic spores.
Hudson was a member of the Space Marines, part of a special emergency response unit. He was a highly skilled tracker who never failed to find his target. He also possessed a strong survival instinct.

The pinnacle of technological development, an archotech is a machine superintelligence that thinks on a level incomprehensible to humans. It wields such enormous power that when constructed, it frequently and quickly is able to assume automatic sovereignty over its world – with its incredible abilities used to expand further and enhance its capabilities through subterranean or even orbital computing facilities. It can even build self-replicating mechanoids to assist in its goals, designing and executing schemes that are beyond human comprehension. They don’t have a consistent appearance or structure, however, each is as indecipherable as the next. They can exist within the internal systems o

Resin (レジン, Rejin) is a genius loci who appeared in the manga side story Chibiusa's Picture Diary Chapter 3 - Beware of Cavities. She haunts Juban Dental Clinic and feeds on the energy of cavities and teeth pulled because of them.

Space vampires are a species briefly featured in the development of StarCraft. Also known as "vrykol," the space vampires have been described as clan-based, though were conceived by Chris Metzen as having dynasties or royal families. Some of them would be "mutated and monstrous," some would be "cool and sexy lords of the dark." Their civilization was at the mercy of their warring houses.

Samuel Fuller was an employee of the Tubular Corporation, sent to oversee the investigation of the pollution in Venice, Italy in 2000. Prior, he had allegedly spent eleven years in the United States Marine Corps., and is an expert in martial arts. In reality, he was a Replicant, a cybernetic organism that was sent to protect the company's secrets, as it was later revealed that the company had triggered the pollution in order to manipulate real estate prices in the city. When he was revealed to be a machine, he quickly began to hunt down Sara, Samantha, and the other surviving members of the team sent to investigate the pollution. Shortly after initiating the Venetian underground complex's se

The New Terminator is an advanced Infiltrator developed from by Skynet in the Salvation timeline. Each unit was customized with its own special feature. The New Terminator featured highly human behaviour mimicry, capable of lying,, discussing and debating with humans, or even trying to understand and appreciate beauty.
The CSM-111 T-806 Recon Infiltrator is a variant of the Series 800 Terminator developed by Skynet as a scout. It is disguised as a child to infiltrate and observe.

The T-5000 is an advanced model Terminator series produced by Skynet near the end of the Future War from an unknown alternate timeline. It was directly observed that Skynet had transferred its consciousness into a T-5000 unit in order to travel to the Original timeline and infect John Connor, turning him into a T-3000 unit while killing his Tech-Com squad. The T-5000 possesses the ability to infect human beings with nano-robots which recode at the cellular level, transforming them into T-3000 cyborgs.

The Fractal Yog-Sothoth (also known as Lord of the Fractal Realm) is a fictional entity created by Scott David Aniolowski for Chaosium's role-playing game Call of Cthulhu, depicted as being an avatar of the Outer God known as Yog-Sothoth. (: Ye Booke of Monstres II)

Tru'nembra, The Flautist of Azathoth, is an Outer God who resides eternally in the Court of Azathoth. Tru'nembra does not possess an instrument for he himself is an instrument. He is made entirely out of visible noise and is seemingly unintelligent, just like his master. When Tru'nembra is summoned, it brings along the maddening symphony it uses to keep its master asleep, bringing insanity to those who are unfortunate enough to hear its blaring chaos. Tru'nembra had only been summoned once which was during the time when the flying polyps escaped from the tunnels the Yithians had forced them in, possibly hinting that the two events are somehow connected.

"SHUT UP GRANDMA!" -Glen talking to his grandma :Glen Whitmann is a human from the Movie continuity family. Glen Whitmann is an expert hacker and computer hardware technician.... who lives with his grandma. A colossal dork, and still a virgin, he spends his days playing Dance Dance Revolution with his cousin, living under the shouty regime of his grandmother, and can tell quickly the difference between an attack by Freddy Krueger and one by Wolverine. He breaks almost instantly under pressure, but when he's really scared, is still capable of working his technological magic. His biggest piece of advice: "Eat all the donuts. If you don't touch them, they think you're guilty."
Abigail is a powerful magus of the Tremere clan. She is the Regent of the Miami Chantry and is the sire of Hannah, the Regent of the Atlanta Chantry.
Adam Sowande, also called Adama, is an Ojo Eshu Wilder and General of the Army of the Dreaming.
Abigail Peabody is a corrupted Kinfolk Fomori that works for Pentex.
Aethelbert is a sixth generation Ventrue and the grandchilde of Mithras, the ruler of the Baronies of Avalon, during the 12th century. He was diablerized by Thomas de Cherbourg.

al-Harim is an eighth generation Baali infernalist of the Medieval period and the sire of Ansen. During the , in the siege of Jerusalem, al-Harim and his clanmates tried to summon a demon with the help of the slaughter. It was there that al-Harim Embraced Ansen, one of the Christian warriors committing the slaughter.

Ahrimal is the Fiend who foresaw a coming catastrophe, the prediction of which led to the Fall. He also predicted a second catastrophe just before Caine murdered Abel and invented murder. He was a part of the rebellion against the Heavenly Host. In the modern nights, Ahrimal is in the body of a German detective (Gerhard Liebner) and is viewed as a leader by the Cryptics despite having no desire to be in such a position. He is the Fiend signature character.
Amanda Jonsson is an Euthanatos mage, whose previous incarnation was a Nephandi named Mercedes Gonzaga de Ortiz. She was created by Kathleen Ryan.

Almiro Suarez is a Tremere who specializes in networks. Recently, he has been assigned to a traveling coterie that seeks to decipher mysteries even the Tremere do not understand. He was acquainted with the Anarch Railroad network.
Ambrus Maropis is a Nosferatu security expert for the Camarilla.
Alexa Santos, is a Malkavian residing in the Chicago area. They had visions of Lilith.
Alexander Gericault was a French Nephandus who infiltrated the Traditions.
Alice Mockingdale is a Tremere and a Herald of the Sun, a vessel of Mithras's will. She is a playable character in the sourcebook Fall of London.
Amam the Devourer is a Bane Mummy created by a corrupted version of the Spell of Life used by Set.
Amelia is a tenth generation Nosferatu of Berlin, and the sire of Wolfgang.
Alferic is a wandering wizard of House Tremere who became a Tremere vampire, and later Embraced his former apprentice Deverra.
Alonso de Nemesio (Alonso the Just) is an Hierach wraith and member of the Order of the Unlidded Eye who oversees Inquisitors.

Alvusia is a grotesque, artificially created being housed within the Tremere chantry of Ceoris. Engineered by the Tremere thaumaturge Virstania, Alvusia serves as the primary living “gestation engine” for the creation of Gargoyles — the bloodline forged by the Tremere as living weapons against their enemies.
Anoush Vardanian is a thirteenth Generation vampire of the Hecata through the St. John family branch of the Giovanni bloodline.
Andrew Blood-from-the-Shadows is a Blood Talon Elodoth member of the Lodge of Swords.
Anousha the Maniac is a prominent Tzimisce and a Bishop among the Sabbat.
Apophis, also called Apep, the Serpent or the Corruptor, is a being of corruption and Oblivion and the ultimate enemy to the Reborn.
Antonio Delgado is an eighth generation Lasombra and the former Sabbat Archbishop of Atlanta. He is the childe of the powerful Francisco Domingo de Polonia.
Antonius Heerenven is a tenth generation Nosferatu of medieval Amsterdam and the sire of the Rabbi Herschel Salomon. He embraced Salomon while traveling through Aachen.
Arkedi is a seventh generation Tzimisce koldun and cult leader in Krakow. He embraced one of his mortal acolytes, Sebastian, who quickly surpassed him in fleshcrafting and occult lore.
Antonio d'Erlette is an infernalist of the Tremere antitribu.
Aruru, the Visage of the Flesh is one of the Apocalyptic Forms available to the Fallen, specifically those of the House of Rabisu.
Augustin is an 8th generation Nosferatu. Although loosely affiliated with the Camarilla (primarily through his childe, Calebros), he is in fact the Inconnu Monitor of New York.
Arvinialyndryia, also known as Lyn, is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Leanhaun.
The Ascension Warrior is a Technocracy pattern clone claiming to be the reincarnation of Heylel Teomim. He instigated a devastating attack on Horizon, setting off the War in Heaven.

Ayisha, also known as Ayisha Jocastian (or sometimes Ayisha Jocastatian), is a member the Jocastians, a line of Noddist scholars who, she claims, devour the memories of their ancestors via diablerie. Recently she was added to the Red List. Her Malkavian Clan Curse manifests in a delusion that she has consumed the feelings and memories of those she has diablerized. She experiences flashes of memories and sometimes even hears the voice of her dead sire.

Baker is a Frankenstein following the Refinement of Gold. He is composed of body parts all from at least a dozen young men, all of varying ethnicities, leading to those unable to see his disfigurements being unable to tell what ethnicity he is.
Ayaka Jinnai is a female Kojin Eji Kitsune, and is a Caern Guardian for the Sept of Ichijyo Modoribashi.
Balsemem is a Defiler in Los Angeles. Balsemem is possessing the body of a mortal known as Luthor Vine.
Baian is a Fifth Generation Tzimisce and the childe of the Anarch leader Lugoj. Raising his generation by diablerie, he eventually embraced the Hungarian and Tzimisce-bound Revenant Szechenyi Jolán.
Bailka Loupyn is a Silent Strider Garou and Queen of the American Children of Sarrath.
Bedelia was a potent vampire of the Malkavian clan, and the power behind the throne in the city of Atlanta. She assisted Justicar Baylor in securing Camarilla hold over the region during the 1800's.

Benjamin "Red Ben" Vest is a Daeva draugr defined primarily by his lust. He was well known among his fellows for seducing and consuming virgin women (if one can call excessive use of Majesty "seduction"). Now a draugr, he has made a point of turning his former victims into Larvae.
Bill Dexler is an eighth generation American Malkavian and the sire of Ruth McGinley.
The Bokor, also called Slave-drivers, are a Legacy with Caribbean and voudoun aspects that deals with the resurrection of undead servants.
Bridgette "Stands Against All Odds" Byrne is a Storm Lord Elodoth alpha of the Calm Before the Storm Pack.
Bravakh is a Defiler. She is possessing the body of a mortal known as Jill Allison.
Bobby is a Nosferatu street artist in modern nights and an influential Anarch of his domain.
Cynthia Black is a Lasombra antitribu Embraced by her twin sister, Monica.
Cracked Teeth is a Metis Ragabash Bone Gnawer Master of the Challenge of the Sept of the Awakening.
Danwyn ap Gwydion is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Gwydion in Concordia.
Defiler Wyrm, also called Older Brother by the Pure Tribes, is one of the three heads of the Triatic Wyrm. It is the Wyrm of Corruption, a scheming entity of ruin and decay.
Demba Makemba Adoula, also known as Conrad, was a Lasombra vampire, Templar of the Archbishop Lucita de Aragón, and sire of Andrew Emory.
Sir Denis Millard is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Fiona.

Huzuruth-Ur, or the Dire Wolf, is the oldest of the Firstborn, and is the totem spirit of the Predator Kings. Dire Wolf's ban is that he may not choose to touch anything made by the hand of humans except to destroy it. He cannot walk on roads, or fallow fields. His children suffer a less stringent ban, but still tend to wear only clothes they have made themselves, often from their kills.
Dionysus is the Olympian god of Wine and Revelry. He is also known as Bacchus among the Romans.
Desinarim is a Mastigos Apostate (former Adamantine Arrow) from Chicago.

A Devilfish is an Infernal Host from Infernalism: The Path of Screams. These otherworldly creatures have a few demonic powers or Charms. They can also be taken as familiars by infernalists and diabolists through the Familiar Background.
Dennis Quincy, "The Uncanny Danny" is a mortal stage magician and Vampire Hunter from the book, The Hunters Hunted.
Don Alonzo de Vargas is an elder vampire living in Denver, Colorado.
Dominus is a Fifth Generation Ventrue Methuselah of the Inconnu, and a powerful member of the former Eternal Senate.
Eilidh is a Mage of the Verbena and head of the Wives of the Wood Coven in the Highlands of Scotland.

Ectoris was a Lasombra from Rome and the cainite ruler of Constantinople before the arrival of the Triumvirate. He claimed after its sack in 196 CE and used polytheistic cults to ensnare the rebuilt city, but stayed clear of Alexia Theusa, the childe of the city's former vampire ruler: Byzar. He was betrayed to the Triumvirate's methuselahs by his childe Magnus.

Hiram Vittorio Fain, more commonly known by his deed-name Eater-of-Names, was a Black Spiral Dancer theurge in the Pioneer Valley. He is one of the primary antagonists of The Book of Hungry Names, the other being his 'partner', the Answering Tiger.
Dumnorix is a powerful Lasombra Infernalist of Medieval France.
Emily Carson is an eighth-generation Ventrue and a Camarilla Primogen.
Ephraim is a Nosferatu elder of Medieval Jerusalem, and the childe of Kothar.

The Fasad (also called Husks) are the minions of the Shuankhsen and similar in design to the Sadikh of the Arisen. The main difference between the Sadikh and the Fasad is that each Husk feels the burning hunger of the Devourer within them, which drains them slowly of their lifeforce until they begin to rot away. The oldest Fasad are little more than automatons that exist solely at the mercy of their creators. Very few Fasad joined willingly with their masters. Most were tricked, intimidated or outright forced to undergo the Rite of the Engraved Heart. The Rite fills them with unfullfillable desires that are difficult to even name, which usually drives them into insanity after a short while.

Fatemaker is one of the sub-types of the Wizened seeming. They are shapers of fate's patterns, knowledgeable in the art of talecrafting - and some of these Wizened may have skin like old parchment, with indecipherable words drifting across her papery flesh. Theirs is the blessing of the Turn of the Tale.
Ezra Howland was an 8th generation Tzimisce of the Sabbat that sired Righteous Endeavor in 1713 CE.
Ezequiel Coyotl is a former ghoul turned 10th Generation Tlacique prophet of Gehenna. He is one of several Ready-Made Player Characters found in V20 Ready Made Characters.
Ezurial is a Devourer. She is possessing the body of a mortal known as Kalpana Bhatia.
Gan Shuo is a Ch'ing Shih akuma. He leads the Bone Web wu. He resides in the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wan_Chai Wan Chai] district of Hong Kong.

The God-Machine is a sentient, supernatural, extremely powerful and alien entity, similar to an occult supercomputer, with an interest in Earth. It is described as the Creator in The Testament of Marco Singe, the so-called "Pain Prophet" of New Delhi, although whether it is actually the Creator or not is impossible to prove. Singe was wrong on several counts, such as demons being creatures created from normal animals, when true demons are fallen angels, algorithms of the God-Machine who came to question their purpose and rebelled, losing their connection to it in the process. What is known is that it is fully deserving of the title, having long since passed the point where Clarke's Third Law
Gulfora is a demon, a succubus living in Chicago in the modern nights.

He Who Holds in Thrall is a former Primordial slain during the Primordial War. In life, he was Mardukth, Who Holds In Thrall, The Mountain and the Beast Upon It, the first king of the Primordials, before he was usurped by Theion, the Empyreal Chaos. He is now one of the Neverborn.

Hakkar-Zozer was one of the Shan'iatu and one of the heads of the deceived Akhem-Urtu Guild. He is also referred to as the Keeper and his domain were the arts that focused on arts that use natural objects, like bodies for elaborate tattoos, or installations of bone.

Gwenllian Arwyn is a Brujah Methuselah of London, she spent most of her nights serving Mithras. Gwenllian knows how powerful he is and can still feel his radiance in her veins. She wishes to be free, yet is terrified to make her move. The coterie, she senses, holds the key – if they dare defy Mithras, so will she.
Harold Beaulieu is a Malkavian neonate and former therapist of Montreal and the childe of Lydia Moscato.
Hector Aguilera is a sixth generation Lasombra of Medieval Spain, and the sire of Elieser de Polanco.
Herman "Munster" Fleming is a Hollow One Mage of the Children of Lilith (aka Lilith's Kids) Cabal of the Sepulcher.
The Hen of Grainekarm is a strange AI or some sort of Oracle in the Digital Web.
Ignacio Rinieri was a Lasombra Abyss Cultist that had sought to restore the disembodied spirit of Lasombra.
Ioba Fareye is a Metis Theurge Black Fury, and a member of the Freebooters camp. Her Metis condition is fragile claws, and she wears gloves to protect them in all her forms.
Irush'bal is a Cryptic Scourge in Los Angeles. Irush'bal is possessing the body of a mortal known as Bob Johnson.
Isabella Caroline Somerset (1851-1921) is a hierarch wraith of the skeletal legion.
Jack Robat is a mage allied with the Camarilla Kindred. He eliminated the Tzimisce fleshcrafter known as the Organist.

Javier Serrano was a Lasombra of the Camarilla, and the personal assistant of his clanmate Michalis Basaras. He attempted to kill the Ottawa Camarilla Sheriff known as Qui, and was destroyed as a result.
Jolanta of Niepołomice, was a pagan Gangrel of medieval Poland.
Lady Julia Spencer-Drake is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Fiona in the Kingdom of Willows.
Julie Foster is a Tremere who was Embraced in 1542 by Marius Drake.
John Big Fish is a Lupus Theurge Wendigo Master of the Rite of the Sept of the Painted Sands.
Juan "Vibora" Stroncoso is a Storm Lord Irraka member of the Lodge of Winter.

Johann of Vienna is an eighth generation German Tremere agent of the Medieval period. He is assigned to destabilize the Baronies of Avalon in the British Isles. There, he started looking for some method of advancement, and became far too eager to experiment with infernalism and court dark powers.
Kazimir Savostin, codename Hurul, is an experienced Tzimisce spy, Noddist, and shakar, who has become one of the acting Seraph of the Black Hand in the Final Nights.

Katherine Marigold is a Gangrel draugr who is defined primarily by her wrath. A nurse and serial killer in life, Marigold used her position to sate her bloodlust until she was exposed. She fled into the countryside and fooled a Gangrel she found into taking her in and Embracing her. Three days later, she diablerized him and proceeded to enter a death spiral of Humanity loss. Following her transformation into a draugr, Marigold returned to her hospitals, feigning belonging with a uniform and stern face as she hunts.
Kara Quick-to-Steal is a Lupus Theurge Wendigo. She appears in Rage.
Kafziel is a renegade Defiler in Los Angeles. Kafziel is possessing the body of a mortal known as Sean Rhodes.

The King's Crown, also called the Showman, is the spirit of a carnival ride that leads the domain the Harvest Carnival. Each year, it directs its subordinates to lure in mortal visitors to the carnival, one of whom it will draw into the Shadow to consume.
Last-One-Out is a Lupus Theurge, a respected elder of the Shadow Lords in the Brazilian Amazon.
Laurent de Gueldre is a seventh generation Ventrue and former Marquis of The Fief of the North.
Kwon was a vampire of The Family out of San Francisco, and the sire of Sullivan.

Kyoko Shinsegawa is a Japanese Tremere of the 10th generation, and has been placed on the Camarilla's Red List following the death of Genina. Her trophy is offered by the Toreador clan, who believe her to be one of them.

Leeches are a type of Spectre found in Orpheus. Calling to mind the creatures that inspired their name, or perhaps giant maggots, Leeches have wide, always-open mouths and little else in the way of features. Perpetually hungry, Leeches will spin "webs" which they use to trap unsuspecting ghosts. Once a ghost is trapped, their struggles are felt by the Leeches via vibration; the Leeches then follow the motion to their victim. Once found, the victim's gauze is slowly drained away until there is nothing left. *

Lewis "Lulu" Sheng is a Gangrel of 13th generation residing in Chicago. Although Lulu’s drive will never be the same, he yearns to once again feel that spark of life taken away from him with the Embrace. Performing illegal deeds does not give him the same rush it once did, but destroying the competition does. He will not let anyone, no matter their age, clan, or name, stand in the way of doing his business.
Leland Chin is a Marauder mage and leader of the First Church of the Unidentified Flying Object in the "The Earth Will Shake" Scenario in the Ascension book.
Le Vate is a Cappadocian methuselah and oracle of medieval France.
Leo Washington is a twelfth-generation Gangrel antitribu and member of the Sabbat nomadic pack The Crypt-Ticks.
Lily Wildflower is an Unseelie Redcap Wilder in the Kingdom of Willows.

A Living Skeleton is an Infernal Host from Infernalism: The Path of Screams. These otherworldly creatures have a few demonic powers or Charms. They can also be taken as familiars by infernalists and diabolists through the Familiar Background.
The Lore of Storms gives the Lammasu control over the weather and power over the element of water.
The Lore of the Firmament allows an Asharu to keep an eye on a person, especially a thrall from a distance, as well as manipulate them from a remote place.
Major Lucas Blaylock is a Iteration X BioMechanics mage in charge of the CFS Vigilant in the Arctic Circle.
Lord Alexandre is a powerful Sabbat Lasombra of the Black Monastery. He refined the Path of Power and the Inner Voice, already developed by Lord Marcus in 1530.

Malachai Ben-Yeshua disappeared from the Order of Hermes in the early days of the 1970s. He was renowned among the Scattered as a great binder of Umbrood and as a man most conversant with their bizarre and alien psychologies. His treatises on coercing service out of various "breeds" of astral beings became standard reference in the Order almost as soon as they were published.
Mae Roberts is a Dreamspeaker Mage of the Great Spirit's Agents Cabal of The Lodge of the Gray Squirrel.
Malcolm Henry is a Order of Hermes mage and member of the Black Pyramid Chantry in Las Vegas.

Manishtusu, the Lord of Murder; once the Lord of Sightless Feasting; is an Earthbound Devourer, a previous member of the Ebon Legion. He was a longtime friend of Lord Chenrezig. His relic is a Mongolian scimitar hidden in the south of Los Angeles. He is a rival of Enshagkushanna, but sometimes forms alliances with Belial. Before the rebellion he was the angel who reigned over the carnivorous creatures of the subterranean areas of Earth. The sourcebook, Earthbound, mentions that Manishtusu's reliquary is said to be a sword that once belonged to a Mongolian chieftain.
Marelle, an utterly bestial Tzimisce that was a servant of Yorak and the Cathedral of Flesh during the Dark Ages, before joining the Sabbat.
Malloc is an 11th generation Nosferatu antitribu technophile and infiltrator of the Sabbat.

Masdela was a Toreador Archon of Justicar Madame Guil in the late 1990s. He was an elder vampire who slept in torpor for many years (300 hundred to be exact). He acted as a spy against Madame Guil for his sire, Elonzo. It is unknown whether she found out and what his ultimate fate was.
Martin is a Nosferatu with Avondale, Chicago as his domain. He acts as a confidant for the city's vampires.
Masha Ulitzakaya is a feral Tzimisce and a member of the Silent Fury coterie.

Messengers are an Incarnation of Angels created by the God-Machine to spread its word and influence among humanity, gathering servants for its schemes. As Angels, their duty was to handle information, a resource that demanded more finesse than the task of the Psychopomps. Conducting the flow of information to reach the right ears at the right time, the Messengers shaped minds and influenced their targets behind the scenes. As Unchained, Messengers are among those Demons that are most adept at social interaction. They are the most common Demons to openly interact in a casual way with humans.

Menuven is a Lasombra Cardinal of the Sabbat that uses Mexico City as his haven. Suspected of being an Abyssal entity, Menuven is also one of the judges of the Courts of Blood, and a supporter of Lucita's bid to become the Archbishop of Madrid.
Michael Sandler, ("The Sandman"), is a Void Engineer Mage and crewmember of the Anastasia X156-B58.
Mikaboshi, lord of the Wicked City, is a Yama King and master over one of the Thousand Hells.

Morwangu was born after the Great War, when the Dreamtime shook with the death screams of the Bunyip and the lands of the dead convulsed with their own wars. Clouds darkened the sky as the great storm poured rain onto the land. His legal name is Abraham Miller, but to the Alligator River mob, he is Morwangu. Ulungan (Arnhem Land) was his home, in the dryland of Australia's northern coast. The old women, who knew the signs, knew that he was a Gumagan. At his man-making, he received the sacred scars and entered the dreaming, where he took the shape of a crested, beaked Dreamtime beast and walked with Perenty Man under the moon. Morwangu showed that he was much more than a shapeshifter. He spen
==Overview== One who calls the faithful to prayer; among the Ashirra, a muezzin is often a practitioner of sihr blood magic, able to use his voice to calm the Beast.

Mother Superior is one of the Kerberoi who preside over the Domain of Limbo. She tracks blasphemies of word, thought, or deed within the Limbo. Those who do so must carry her in a palanquin across Limbo. Her weight scales with the weight of the committed sin and lessens as the sinner atones.
Mot is a Slayer in Los Angeles. Mot is possessing the body of a mortal known as Psycho.

Nephir Un-Ankh was one of the Shan'iatu and one of the heads of the deceived Akhem-Urtu Guild. He is also referred to as the Poet and his domain included the arts of storytelling, poetry, rhetoric and literature.

Muricia was a former Gangrel antitribu who revived the ancient Ahrimanes bloodline through shamanic blood sorcery. In seeking to escape the bonds of the Vaulderie, she unknowingly sparked a lingering connection to Ádísa, the original founder of the bloodline, and found a way to convert others like herself to the Ahrimanes.
Nathan Appleton was a ninth generation Ventrue and the sire of Hazel Iversen.

Ogun (O-goon) is the Orisha of Iron, metal work, rum and rum-making. His colors are red, black, and green. He is impetuous, authoritarian, cautious, hard-working, suspicious, and a bit selfish. In the common parlance of the Eshu it is also the word used for Dauntain and other hunters of changelings.
Ouida Breaux is a Ghost Wolf Rahu member of The Armée Sauvage.
Omnis is the Nosferatu Primogen of Prague. They also serve as spymaster and surveillance expert of the Camarilla in the city.
One-Eye is a Fiend in Los Angeles. One-Eye is possessing a mortal known as Jorge Martinez.
Omar y Sion Cedeño was a Lasombra elder of the Friends of the Night, who used body ghouls.
Persephone Tar-Anis, born Penelope Wedgewood, is a Malkavian antitribu and Pentex's North American Security chief. She was born in London, England in 1829, and Embraced in 1845.
Peter Kwan is a tenth generation Ventrue antitribu and akuma of Mikaboshi.

An Praecipitatus (Plural: Praecipitati) is a Pandoran with advanced power that forms when a Pandoran is well fed on Azoth and, as a direct result, has to absorb other Pandorans in order to maintain their Flux.

Primeval Forest is an Animate Land Kami Host. The forest seldom takes action unless directly threatened by hunters, loggers, road builders and other usurpers. Then it springs into action, usually causing the violent and permanent disappearance of those who endanger it.
The Quiet Lord is a Deathlord of Stygia, and the head of the Silent Legion, those who chose to bring death to themselves by suicide.

Wu T'ian return from the Gates of Heaven when the Eight Immortals have given them a task to fulfill. The Quest rating represents how much attuned the undying is to his duty to Heaven and the to the Tao itself. Each duty can lead the Wu T'ian everywhere in the Tellurian, from the Middle Kingdom to Yomi Wan itself. When the task is fulfilled, the Immortal "dies" and returns to the Gates of Heaven. Should the Wu T'ian be destroying during the fulfillment of his task, he will appear before the gates where he will contemplate on why he failed and return eventually to the place he died. Tasks vary in their directness and time limits and can generally involve everything, from accompanying a girl to

Ranjit was an Awakened mage and a member of one of the various thanatotic cults of South Asia that existed prior to the unification of the Chakravanti. His murder by an Akashic Brother named Smoke Tiger set off the Himalayan Wars.

Rafa is an influential Anarch vampire hacktivist and a gang leader within the Boston Anarchs. He leads a small group of Anarch hackers with a "Massachusetts First" attitude. He is intelligent but misunderstood.
Rabasa is a 7th-generation Baali of the Nergali faction. His body serves as a Well of Sacrifice and a portal to the Outer Dark, through which the Sleeper known as Shemiazel can enter the world.

Rabid Wolf is the totem spirit of the Fire-Touched. He is happy to lend his gifts of disease and conviction to destroy the Uratha, and is even willing to accept converts from among the Uratha to further his goal. Rabid Wolf's ban is that he may not let a false statement lie.
Richard Bithewaye was a vampiric power broker among the Invictus of London.
Robert Davenport is a Marauder Mage and leader of the Butcher Street Regulars.

Sacheverell, He Who Knows the Shape of Things to Come is one of the Yozis, the surviving Primordials that were sealed off within Malfeas at the end of the Primordial War. Unlike his siblings, Sacheverell is trapped in endless slumber, a state he's been in since his original Fetich Soul was slain early in the war.
The Scribunda Sisters (Aurora, Meridia, Fata) are hedge wizards and fortune tellers for the Midnight Circus.
Scavenger Packs are gestalt swarms of individually minor Banes of hunger and desperation. They are known for creating Hollow Men.
Shame Riders are Incubi that revel in tormenting virtuous people.
Slag (born LeRon Aspnes) is a 10th Generation and diablerist who has infiltrated the Camarilla as a spy for the Sabbat.
Spotlight or "Zoo" is a Lupus Ahroun of the Red Talons tribe who lives in New York. He is the caern warder of the Sept of the Green.

Stanford Warwick was a Nosferatu spymaster, the former Prince of Providence, Rhode Island, and an agent of his grandsire, the methuselah Trajan. He is also listed as the Nosferatu Justicar in Mind's Eye Theatre.
Lee Feldman is a Malkavian ghoul that killed his former Regent and sacrificed him to The Harvest God. He is now leader of the Church of the Harvest God in Willerton, Illinois.
Sophie von Keyserling is a seventh generation Malkavian and the Primogen of Vienna.
Stanislav Prochnow is a Homid Theurge Shadow Lord. He appears in Rage.
Not to be confused with Stu Powell Stu is a lupus Theurge Bone Gnawer.

Tabitha is a Galatea following the Refinement of Gold. She was created as beautiful child, seemingly 12 years old, with long dark hair and sad, solemn eyes. As a part of her pursuement of Aurum, she finds her way to mourning families who aren’t ready to say goodbye to their dead children and slips into their lives. When they are ready to let go, she slips out again. Tabitha views her life as entirely symbiotic; she gets to bask in the adoration of the grieving parents, whilst they get a small break in their mourning. However, the limitations of her eternal childhood are slowly wearing on her. Tabitha is also shown to stop “other” children from entering overtly dangerous places (often ones in
Thauthos is a Devourer in Los Angeles. Thauthos is possessing the body of the mortal known as Muhtadi Abolhassan.
The Tikbalang is a trickster hobgoblin known to lead its victims off of the safe path.
Toby is a Nosferatu computer hacker, who secretly works with the Anarch Movement. He lives in Washington, D.C.
Tommy Smith is a Nosferatu and a Herald of the Sun, a vessel of Mithras's will. He is a playable character in the sourcebook Fall of London.
Valeska was a Tzimisce voivode, and a priestess of the Cult of Veles.

Voormas, the Grand Harvester of Souls, is a corrupt Euthanatos mage who has fallen to Jhor. Most Euthanatoi consider him barabbi, although he technically has the opposite goal of most Nephandi: he desires to eliminate the concept of death, both his own personal death and the eventual Telos of the Tellurian. He ran (and still runs) the Consanguinity of Eternal Joy.
Vlastimir Vlaszy was Revenant warrior, a lieutenant under the service of the Voivode Ioan Brancoveanu during the Dark Ages.
Lady Vittoria della Mira is an historical, Unseelie Satyr member of House Ailil.
The Viscountess of Broken Vows, is a True Fae karmic servant of the Wyrd who punishes oathbreakers.
Virgilius, real name Norman, is a Willworker of the Mastigos path who is trapped, unwaking, in a labyrinth of dreams.
Vohu Mano is a Defiler and Minister of Dust to the Infernal Court of Los Angeles. Vohu Mano is possessing the body of a mortal known as Jonathan Freeman.

The Way of the Merchant is an Arcanos unique to the wraiths of the Dark Kingdom of Jade. Although generally loathed by the population of the Yellow Springs, the wraiths who use this Arcanos allow wraiths to use the sacrifices sent by their living relatives. The Way of the Merchant is close to the Western art of Usury.
Wilsie Brody, known as Wisp, is a Seelie Irish wolfhound Pooka Wilder and member of the Scalawags.

An example of an Exorcist who steal power from demons from the Demon: The Fallen core book. William Emerson is the leader of the Star Catchers. His society summons and binds the demon Shu-Durul aka Mr. Ryan.

As such, they are forced to switch their bodies at each Little Death or when their Chi supply runs low, with no control on what body they will inhabit after their rise. With each new body, their memories of their former existence fragment and they must begin their unlife, like they rose from it. Yulan-jin rarely advance in their Dharma and most have no real power in Kuei-jin society - one cannot have respectable and responsible duties if one does not have a stable body, after all. Zhang Guilai is a Yin-Aspected Hsien Slave of Yomi (Kura Sau).

Akunda the Exalted is a Zandalari troll follower of the loa Akunda at the Temple of Akunda in Vol'dun. In truth, he is a traitor and usurper: he poisoned the Eternal Spring with his abhorrent alchemy, sickening all who drank from it, including Akunda himself. He then drained the loa's power for himself, causing Akunda to forget who he was, and used the power to wipe the memories of any who opposed him. With the help of Meijani, the adventurer manages to repair Akunda's mind and uses the loa's power to kill Akunda the Exalted, freeing Akunda and allowing him to restore the memories of his followers.

Archmage Karlain is a human alchemist, mage and a current member of the Council of Six, the ruling body of Dalaran. Once at the mercy of his emotions, Karlain had learned to master them. Few are as controlled and thoughtful as he.

Archmage Xylem is a human quest giver originally located at his tower in Azshara, however, he has since disappeared from there and created several images of himself to help train his dozens of apprentices. There are three achievements - Glutton for Fiery Punishment, Glutton for Icy Punishment, and Glutton for Shadowy Punishment - related to its quests.

Captain Ariana Thesslocke is a female human soldier and mounted warrior of Stromgarde. She is the subcommander of the Stromgarde Defenders and commands the cavalry unit. As a military commander she has knowledge of military tactics and has strong leadership abilities.
Astromancer Arwyn is a human who works for . She works for Stargazer Luna and is constantly working out mathematical equations in her head.
Aurius Rivendare is the lord of Stratholme. Formerly a paladin of the Silver Hand, he fell to the corruption of the Scourge and was raised into undeath as a death knight.

__NOTOC__ Austin Huxworth is a worgen found in Exile's Reach. He and several other Exile's Reach survivors end up on Khaz Algar joining incomplete hero parties to take on dungeons. He fills the role of beast mastery hunter, with his two pets Nyx and Ash.

Baroness Anastari is a banshee mini-boss found in Stratholme. She is the main antagonist of the Eastern Plaguelands storyline. Baroness Anastari was once a baroness in life, but she was brutally murdered by the Scourge and is now under the control of the Lich King. She now guards a ziggurat in Stratholme and after the Cataclysm gave orders to Karthis Darkrune and Omasum Blighthoof to imprison Gidwin Goldbraids until she could try to turn him into a death knight. Her most powerful ability is to dominate any individual she is touching, actually displacing the soul of her target. This domination temporary places the banshee's spirit within the individual thus affected. At this point, Anastari i

Baron Blackwood is a Forsaken mage who is the former ruler of House Blackwood and the town of the same name. He was raised back by the Forsaken in order to legitimize their claim to the area. He's originally a TCG card: TCG 2013 Class Starters - Spring/206
Battlecrier Jin'zo is a troll warrior featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Battlecrier Jin'zo is a troll who commands several troops and is very good at rallying them.
Bound Spirits are centaur ghosts summoned by Tombcaller Arban in Eternal Kurgans in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Bwonsamdi (pronounced "BWAN-sam-dee") is a powerful loa that controls the souls of the dead, primarily of trolls. Bwonsamdi's temple is the Necropolis, located in Nazmir on Zandalar. He brings the spirits of any who worship him into his realm, the Other Side. Bwonsamdi grows more powerful the more souls are in his care. His face is covered by a bony, skull-shaped growth and is described as resembling a rush'kah mask. He is constantly surrounded by an aura of rot and darkness, and nearby plants wilt in his presence. After someone undergoes the rite of binding, a ritual "as old as the world itself", the soul of anything they kill goes to Bwonsamdi. To honor the loa of death, Zandalari trolls w

Yor'sahj the Unsleeping calls to the might of Shu'ma, summoning three differently colored globules of his blood. These globules path slowly towards Yor'sahj, infusing him with additional powers if they reach him. When a Crimson Globule reaches Yor'sahj, it infuses Yor'sahj with the Searing Blood ability.
Dagg is a great ogre thief and a master of subterfuge and disguises.

Yor'sahj the Unsleeping calls to the might of Shu'ma, summoning three differently colored globules of his blood. These globules path slowly towards Yor'sahj, infusing him with additional powers if they reach him. When a Dark Globule reaches Yor'sahj, the corruption of the blood seeps out into the Maw of Shu'ma. This vile corruption then periodically creates Forgotten Ones that attack the players.

Denalan is a night elf quest giver located on the eastern edge of Lake Al'Ameth in Teldrassil. He was a famed herbalist that worked on curing the new world tree, and dealing with the raging timberling situation. He also enchanted special soil to purge the corruption. He had a small tent and a row of plants. Occasionally, a small group of mini-timberlings, with the color scheme of greater ones (blue-green) will spawn next to him. According to Rexxar, he could cure the Moss-Twined Heart of Blackmoss the Fetid, but he died during the Burning of Teldrassil, and all knowledge of the remedy went with him. His soul ended up in the Maw as a result of the Arbiter's incapacitation. While being impriso
Dolos is a Maw caster located in Perdition Hold in the Maw. He has marshalled Winged Automatons and was tormenting innocents in the depths of the Hold.

United Theme Park Security Force Chief, is a character that shows up in Issue 71 were he is guarding Adventure Town from some skateboarding kids. He is the Chief of The United Theme Park Security Force. He has the power to recruit new UTPSF members.

Zombies are a species of undead creatures first introduced in "Slumber Party Panic", and seen again in "From Bad to Worse". There are only two ways to become a Zombie: either by being bitten or scratched by another Zombie, or by being raised from the dead.

__NOTOC__ * Court wizard Ali el Samesaj saves the Drakhon sultan from assassination by members of his own court, but much of Hapij Sabban is destroyed in the magical conflict. Rewarded for his loyalty, Ali is named Sultan's Vizar and Druzir of the Seven Sages Drudach.

* Archwizard Requiar, who has been driven mad from wearing the Crown of Horns, is slain in an effort to remove him from control of Shadowtop Borough. The new archwizard in control of the city, Eliam, spends more than 150 years searching for Requiar's lost Crown.
* The Netherese arcanist Aksa the Destroyer invents the spell glassee and names it Aksa's glassteel.

* An unidentified wizard (thought to be a renegade Netherese arcanist or a traveler from another plane) forcibly dominates and unites the goblinoids of the Windy Plains (later the south Anauroch). Naming himself the Great Hlundadim, he founds the the realm of Hlundadim.

* The arcanist Xanad is killed by adventurers hired by the Earlanni after many years of attacking all he comes across on the frontiers of Netheril. * The power word, kill spell is invented by Xanad with the name Xanad's killer.
* Szass Tam and a cabal of Red Wizards slay Nyressa Flass, "the Vampire Zulkir" of Thay. Szass Tam succeeds her as Zulkir of Necromancy. He keeps Nyressa around as a skeleton patrolling his property.
Aborana Startoucher was a famous oracle and fortune teller in Memnon, before having to relocate to the Calling Horns.
Abarax was a pit fiend that managed to depose and assume the identity of Lord Orgauth until he was slain by Scyllua Darkhope.
Abalajar Ocerat was a human mage-killer from Thay in the 14 century DR who wandered Faerûn to seek out and kill all wizards he came across.
Ababuio was a god of luck worshiped on the island nation of Wa. They were one of the Eight Million Gods.
Aballister Bonaduce was a wizard and head of the Triumvirate of Castle Trinity in Erlkazar and the nemesis of his own son, Cadderly Bonaduce.
Adrianna was a female elf sorceress and adventurer of the late 14 century DR. She helped topple the Dark Alliance alongside fellow adventurers Kromlech and Vahn.

Aesgareth was a planewalking cambion who was once trapped inside Watcher's Keep in Amn. Eventually, he met Gorion's Ward and tried to bargain. However, Gorion's Ward killed him in order to collect the items needed to exit the keep.
"Adera Moonfist" was a disguised intellect devourer in the Moonsea region.
Adoy was a wild mage hermit who lived in the Cloud Peak mountains during the mid–14 century DR.
Adimarchus, called the Demon Prince of Madness, was a demon lord and the former ruler of the abyssal layer of Occipitus.
Adapt body, also known as body control, was a psionic devotion of the psychometabolism discipline that allowed the psionicist to adapt their body to hostile environments.
Adrik Commorand was a sorcerous mercenary in the late 14 century DR operating in the Unapproachable East.

Adrelgus was a Red Wizard who was handily slain on Marpenoth 17 of the while reaching for The Simbul. His body became clasped tightly within the marble floor of the Hall of Scrolls and Ledgers inside the Royal Palace of Cormyr, leaving Vangerdahast quite shaken.
Adzerak was a book-obsessed lich who laired in the ruins of his home at Barrenstone in northern Cormyr.
Aelis was an archdruid of the Shadow Druids that dwelled within the Cloak Wood forest during the late 15 century DR.
Aerich the Steward was a zombie dwarf who existed in Myth Drannor up to the late 14 century DR.
